text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a Frost Advisory for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. No crashes nearby right now, but 7 construction zones could slow you down. It's 41°F, Sunny, up to 60°. Trick-or-treating tonight? Bring a flashlight and watch for kids crossing.
